status_rule: optimal_inaccurate is provisional and is accepted only after numerical recertification and independent-solver agreement
timeout_rule: retain and report the run; never delete it; a feasible incumbent may be reported only after full scenario recertification
infeasibility_rule: do not declare infeasibility from an inaccurate status; require agreement of two solvers or an analytical certificate
stage1_claim_rule: report exact optimality only when complete enumeration or a valid global certificate exists; otherwise report a certified feasible incumbent, an SDP bound, and their bound gap
